newsitem.title: USA: ABM Industries acquires Ogden unit.
newsitem.headline: ABM Industries acquires Ogden unit.

text.p: ABM Industries Inc said Friday it has acquired Ogden Corp's $150 million per year building maintenance and on-site engineering operations in New York City.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
"The sale of the New York Facility Services group completes the divestiture of Ogden's building maintenance business," Ogden Chairman and Chief Executive R. Richard Ablon said in a statement.

"This transaction brings us one step closer to the finalization of our company's strategic refocusing. We fully expect the remaining businesses to be disposed of in due course. While the asset sales process is winding down, our focus continues to remain solely on building leadership positions in our entertainment, aviation and energy businesses," he said.
